# Installing mixAR

‘mixAR’ is an R package for time series modelling with mixture
autoregressive and related models.

Install the [latest stable
version](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mixAR) from CRAN:

``` R
install.packages("mixAR")
```

Alternatively, install the [development
version](https://github.com/GeoBosh/mixAR) of `mixAR` from Github:

``` R
remotes::install_github("GeoBosh/mixAR")
```

# Overview

Package `mixAR` provides functions for modelling with mixture
autoregressive (MAR/mixAR) models.

See, for example, the [overview of
mixAR](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR-package.html) and
model fitting functions such as
[fit_mixAR](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/fit_mixAR-methods.html)
and
[bayes_mixAR](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/bayes_mixAR.html).

# Package index

## mixAR overview

- [`mixAR-package`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR-package.md)
  : Mixture Autoregressive Models

## EM and Bayesian estimation of mixture autoregressive models

Fit mixture autoregressive models using the EM algorithm or MCMC.

- [`fit_mixAR()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/fit_mixAR-methods.md)
  : Fit mixture autoregressive models
- [`bayes_mixAR()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/bayes_mixAR.md)
  : Bayesian sampling of mixture autoregressive models
- [`fit_mixARreg()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/fit_mixARreg-methods.md)
  [`mixARreg()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/fit_mixARreg-methods.md)
  : Fit time series regression models with mixture autoregressive
  residuals
- [`mixSARfit()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixSARfit.md)
  : Fit mixture autoregressive models with seasonal AR parameters
- [`tsdiag(`*`<MixAR>`*`)`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR_diag.md)
  [`mixAR_diag()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR_diag.md)
  : Diagnostic checks for mixture autoregressive models
- [`mix_se()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mix_se-methods.md)
  : Compute standard errors of estimates of MixAR models
- [`mixAR_BIC()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR_BIC.md)
  [`BIC_comp()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixAR_BIC.md)
  : BIC based model selection for MixAR models

## EM and other utilities for mixAR models

EM and other utilities for mixAR models.

- [`em_est_dist()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/em_est_dist.md)

  : Update the scale parameters of MixAR models

  Gaussian EM-step with random initialisation

  components

  model.

  [`mixARgenemFixedPoint()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixARemFixedPoint.md)

  [`mixMstep()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/mixMstep.md)

  : Estimate probabilities of a MixAR model from tau.

  : Closing prices of four stocks

## Internal utility functions

- [`adjustLengths()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/adjustLengths.md)
  : Adjust the length of the second argument to be the same as that of
  the first one

- [`.canonic_coef()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/xxcanonic_coef.md)
  : Put core MixAR coefficients into a canonical form, internal function

- [`companion_matrix()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/companion_matrix.md)
  : Create a companion matrix from a vector

- [`err_k()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/err_k.md) :
  Utility function for MixAR

- [`err()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/err.md) :
  Calculate component specific error terms under MixAR model

- [`initialize-methods`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,MixAR-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,raggedCoef-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,raggedCoefS-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,MixARgen-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,raggedCoefV-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  [`initialize,MixVAR-method`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/initialize-methods.md)
  :

  Methods for function `initialize` in package mixAR

- [`lastn()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/lastn.md) :
  Extract the last n elements of a vector

- [`permn_cols()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/permn_cols.md)
  : All permutations of the columns of a matrix

- [`ui()`](https://geobosh.github.io/mixAR/reference/ui.md) : Utility
  function for mixAR
